name: What are the most common mistakes in luxury home design?

mainEntity.name: What mistakes do homeowners make most often when designing a luxury home in Los Angeles?
mainEntity.text: What mistakes do homeowners make most often when designing a luxury home in Los Angeles?

acceptedAnswer.text: The biggest luxury design mistakes usually happen before construction even begins. Many homeowners wait too long to involve the designer, which leads to missed opportunities and expensive changes. Others underestimate how much custom cabinetry, stone, lighting, and specialty finishes will cost once the project is fully specified. Another common problem is focusing on aesthetics without enough attention to function, storage, or maintenance. In Los Angeles luxury homes, poor coordination between architect, builder, and interior designer can also create delays and mismatched details. A home may look impressive on paper but feel awkward if circulation, scale, or lighting are not thought through carefully. The safest path is a master plan with clear priorities, realistic budget ranges, and early decisions on major materials and systems. That reduces rework and helps the finished home feel cohesive rather than overdesigned.
acceptedAnswer.description: The most common mistakes are starting too late, underbudgeting finishes, choosing style over function, skipping a master plan, and failing to coordinate the architect, designer, and builder. Other issues include too many custom choices, poor lighting planning, and ignoring storage or maintenance needs.
